name: tract_developer_subdivision
description: Test 22 inside full Grows, by hand from 4.3, 4.9.3, 4.15.1, 4.15.4 and 4.16. Residential developer, one configuration of size (2, 3) (primary family 600 = {0x300}, capacity 10), no styles, no anchor. Part 1: demand 100 (desired 100, desiredMax 150); one empty lot at location (20, 10), facing 2, size (6, 3) (rect 20..25 x 8..10), tract (5, 2). Existing listing: size differs (5); aggregation: cw < w (5); subdivision: 6 mod 2 = 0 and h = ch -> a type-4 candidate with n = 3. Build: PickBuilding (R4 of 1, R5 of 1; window lo = 1 / 3 = 0, hi 150), Claim(10) then Release(10), then PerformSubdivision: demolish and delete the parent; target = 150 - 0 + 0 = 150; pieces (2, 3) at origin z += 1 - 3 -> (20, 8), (22, 8), (24, 8) (step x += 2), each claimed and started with capacity 10; pieces 2 and 3 repeat PickBuilding (R4, R5 each). Build returns 27 (built 30 < 100, so a relaxed pass follows): the pieces in the tract are in state 2 (existing 4, aggregation 5 for equal sizes, subdivision 4): best 5 is pushed and ends the call: outcomes [27, 5], built 30; the anchor test sees the candidate's template rect (-1, -1, -1, -1) ([inferred]: type 4 never sets c.rect, FindNetworks uses the lot's rect). Part 2: facing 0, same sizes, location (20, 10) (rect 15..20 x 10..12), tract (4, 2), demand 10 (desired 10, desiredMax 15): pieces at x += 1 - 2 -> (19, 10), (17, 10), (15, 10) (step x -= 2). Target 15; piece 1 is built (built 10); pieces 2 and 3 re-run PickBuilding with the cached window lo 0, hi max(15 - 10 + 0, 1) = 5 < capacity 10 -> code 13, no building (R4 only, no R5), so they stay empty lots; built 10 >= desired: outcomes [27], one pass. Each part runs on a new instance with new file-local statics (CRT state 1, so R1 starts at 9 both times); the chosen configuration and building are cleared at the start of the relaxed pass of part 1.
